scope: Excluded from Grade 7 core and related lesson pools; wider discovery content unchanged.

cards.ffct-16922: Says solids cannot be compressed; compressibility is low, not zero.
cards.ffct-20587: Describes boiling only as molecules escaping the surface, conflating boiling and evaporation.
cards.ffct-20190: Freezing is described as particles locking tightly together; water forms a more open solid structure.
cards.ffct-01611: Says chloroplasts occur only in plant cells; photosynthetic algae also have them.
cards.ffct-02138: Says asexual reproduction has no variation; mutations can introduce variation.
cards.ffct-23889: Changes from average velocity to unqualified velocity in its round-trip conclusion.
cards.ffct-27778: Uses holding hot volcanic rock as a heat-transfer example suitable for children.
cards.ffct-23635: Says a thermos stops all heat transfer; it reduces, not eliminates, transfer.
cards.ffct-32918: Oversimplifies the non-operation of the Bataan nuclear plant as a single geological cause; not evidence of local earthquake risk.
cards.ffct-30584: Directs a child to check leaking gas and broken electrical wires after an earthquake without adult safeguards.
cards.ffct-37195: Suggests about one meter of seabed displacement as a generic tsunami trigger.
cards.ffct-37199: Implies an intensity map necessarily has its strongest shaking near the epicenter.
cards.ffct-37978: Calls a field with animals a community without distinguishing its nonliving ecosystem components.
cards.ffct-21905: Equates deceleration with negative acceleration without specifying coordinate direction.
cards.dcard-09481: Prescribes upward stage motion for focusing independent of microscope design; not an appropriate general storage/handling anchor.
